name: Sorbitol
aliases: E420, E420i, E420ii, sorbitol, sorbitol syrup, D-glucitol, D-glucitol syrup, sorbitol, jarabe de sorbitol
what_is: A low-calorie polyol sugar alcohol used as a sweetener and bulking agent.
why_botia: It flags it because it can induce laxative effects at high doses and serves as an industrial sugar replacer in ultra-processed products.
can_1: Identify E420 and flag the mandatory EU warning 'excessive consumption may produce laxative effects' if present above 10%.
can_2: Trigger the sweetener layer and notify of its low-glycemic properties.
cannot_1: Verify the exact percentage of sorbitol added if it is below the 10% warning threshold.
cannot_2: Determine if the sorbitol was manufactured from corn starch or wheat starch.
title: Sorbitol
description: A low-calorie polyol sugar alcohol used as a sweetener and bulking agent.
